_comment: Model per agent for both adapters. Pick a profile at build time: FORGE_MODELS=balanced npm test (default: rigor). Claude Code gets the alias as-is. OMP gets the matching `omp` selector as the agent's default `model:` (exact id first, bare alias as fallback); users still change it in OMP /agents, and install.sh keeps already-installed agent files. forge-requirement carries the whole Requirement gate (incl. the adversarial pass), so it stays on opus in every profile but economy.
